audit.removalReason: Zamana Gawah Hai is an Asif Hameed current-affairs programme and the Tanzeem-e-Islami institutional channel publishes sermons by Shujauddin Sheikh and other speakers. Neither channel is a Dr. Israr Ahmed lecture source; the records were removed from his library.
audit.verificationMethod: YouTube oEmbed title/author; playableInEmbed checked where YouTube did not rate-limit the request
audit.note: playbackStatus AVAILABLE_AT_SOURCE means the video exists at its published YouTube URL (oEmbed HTTP 200). VERIFIED_PLAYABLE is reserved for records whose playback was actually started in a browser. EMBED_RESTRICTED means the uploader disabled embedding. REMOVED_AT_SOURCE is a historical archive record.
audit.embeddingStatusNote: During the first bulk pass, 320 newly added records returned playableInEmbed=true and none returned false. YouTube then rate-limited its watch-page metadata endpoint (HTTP 429), so the remaining records are marked UNKNOWN rather than guessed. Actual browser playback is recorded separately in AUDIT/FINAL-COMPLETE-WEBSITE-AUDIT.md.
audit.browserPlaybackNote: Each record below was actually started in the official YouTube IFrame Player from the local test page. Pause, resume, seek and volume were exercised through the player API. Fullscreen could not be verified because the test browser window was not visible; that limitation is recorded in AUDIT/FINAL-COMPLETE-WEBSITE-AUDIT.md.

mp4RightsPolicy.note: Technical playback verified on 13 November 2026 (HTTP 206, video/mp4, Accept-Ranges: bytes, H.264 1280x720 + AAC stereo 48 kHz, seeking supported). The Internet Archive item metadata contains no licenseurl, rights statement, creator or written permission from the rights-holder, so redistribution permission is NOT established. The direct player is therefore disabled and only an attributed source link is shown.

retrySample.note: A 30-record retry sample of NOT_VERIFIED entries was replayed with a 30s timeout; most converted to VERIFIED_PLAYABLE, showing that the 12s batch timeout — not an embedding restriction — caused most NOT_VERIFIED results.

browserPlaybackBatch.notVerifiedReason: Most NOT_VERIFIED entries reached player state 3 (BUFFERING) but did not reach PLAYING with currentTime > 0.3s within the 12s timeout. They remain AVAILABLE_AT_SOURCE rather than being claimed as playable.
browserPlaybackBatch.fullscreen: NOT VERIFIED — the test browser window was not visible, so requestFullscreen() remained pending and document.fullscreenElement stayed null.
